Forward payment voucher screenshot via WhatsApp for instant verification.

data.participationGuidelines: Participants should have a reasonable level of fitness to complete the hike within the designated timeframe. Recommended age requirement: 13 to 50 years (participants outside this range are welcome with a friend, guardian, or self-reliant hiking fitness). Individuals whose fitness might cause severe delays are advised to consult coordinators beforehand for safety.

safetyRules.title: Hike Sign-up
safetyRules.description: Hikers must officially register for each hike they wish to attend.

safetyRules.title: Punctuality
safetyRules.description: Members must arrive at the designated meeting point at the specified time.

safetyRules.title: Safety First
safetyRules.description: All participants follow the instructions of designated hike leader(s) at all times.

safetyRules.title: Medical Conditions
safetyRules.description: Members are responsible for their health and must inform organizers of pre-existing conditions.

safetyRules.description: Hikers shall not tamper with nature, private agriculture, or local culture in any way.

title: Gosainkunda Holy Lakes & Lauribina Ridge Trek

data.title: Gosainkunda Holy Lakes & Lauribina Ridge Trek
data.pricingNotes: Complete 5-day lodge trek package with roundtrip Jeep & permits
costIncludes: Kathmandu - Dhunche - Kathmandu Private Reserved Jeep
All Meals on Trek (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner + Hot Tea)
Langtang National Park Entry Permit & TIMS
Certified Wilderness Guide & First-Aid Oxygen Support
costExcludes: Personal porter for backpack (available on request)
Hot showers, battery charging & bottled water in high teahouses

addOns.name: Single Room Upgrade (Subject to Teahouse Availability)

data.addOnsNotice: Porters must be booked at least 4 days in advance to ensure mountain permits.

itineraryDays.title: Kathmandu to Dhunche & Trek to Deurali (2625m)

items.activity: Drive from Kathmandu to Dhunche by private Jeep (6 hrs)
Lunch at Dhunche & permit verification at military checkpost
Commence uphill trail through dense pine & bamboo woods
Arrive at Deurali teahouse. Dinner & rest

itineraryDays.title: Deurali to Chandanbari / Sing Gompa & Cholangpati (3584m)

items.activity: Breakfast & start trek along ridge toward Sing Gompa
Visit local yak cheese factory at Sing Gompa & lunch
Climb toward Cholangpati with panoramic Langtang Himal views
Overnight at Cholangpati mountain lodge

itineraryDays.title: Cholangpati to Lauribina Ridge & Sacred Gosainkunda Lake (4380m)

items.activity: Sunrise trek up steep Lauribinayak pass above the treeline
Witness Saraswati Kunda, Bhairav Kunda and Holy Gosainkunda
Hot lunch at lake lodge & exploration of holy shrines
Star-gazing & high-altitude overnight by the holy lake

itineraryDays.title: Gosainkunda Sunrise & Scenic Descent to Sing Gompa

items.activity: Sunrise prayer and photography at the lake rim
Descend through Lauribina ridge enjoying Ganesh Himal views
Arrive at Sing Gompa for hot lunch & relax
Farewell celebratory dinner at the lodge

itineraryDays.title: Sing Gompa to Dhunche & Drive Back to Kathmandu

items.activity: Final morning downhill trek to Dhunche valley
Board return private Jeep at Dhunche
Arrive Kathmandu (Machhapokhari) - Trip concludes
